run_metadata.seed_myth:
Myth: In the moment of revelation, the Flame-Keeper saw what the Wind-Dancer had seen—the cruel veil between their towers. All those offerings lost in invisible barriers, all that confusion mistaken for abandonment.

But something had shifted. Perhaps the veil had thinned, or perhaps they'd finally learned the right words to pierce it. Because this time, when the Wind-Dancer released their full breath—not a tentative whisper but a powerful gale of trust—it reached the Flame-Keeper's tower completely.

She stood holding the multiplied light, tears streaming down her face. "You sent everything," she whispered. "After all the silence, all the hurt, you trusted me with your entire wind."

The Flame-Keeper understood: this was the moment that mattered. Not the confusion of the past, not the barriers that had separated them, but this present choice.

She gathered the brightest flames and sent them back on that same wind—a generous return, proof that the trust was not misplaced.

As the flames danced back across the space between towers, she saw the truth clearly: "We were never truly apart in spirit, only in the paths our gifts traveled. Now those paths are clear. Now the dance can truly begin again."

The horizon blazed with renewed light.
